limitations: Authored scene, three visually distinct products and guided learning; no claim of general recognition accuracy or hardware readiness.
Original and explicitly clarified inputs are separate conditions.
Later legs are untested when an earlier leg blocks the chain.
Identity margin failure is recorded, but exact rival similarity scores are not retained in current runtime traces.
Provider reported cost does not cap unknown or in-flight charges.
